author: Screen Junkies
description:
It's another SDCC special Movie Fight, this time with the author of Dungeon Crawler Carl Matt Dinniman vs. audiobook narrator / Princess Donut Jeff Hays!

FIGHTS
1:36 What's the best life or death game in TV & Movie History?
4:17 What's the greatest sci-fi / fantasy book-to-screen adaptation of all time?
5:01 Who would last longer in the dungeon: Gossip Girl or Gilmore Girls?
7:15 What movie or TV setting would make the best setting for a dungeon floor?
9:36 What character from another franchise would make the best addition to the royal court?
title: Dungeon Crawler Carl's Author and Narrator Fight About Movies
